sourceReview: AGENTS, complete task, two runtime files, all test/recording/auditor sources, primary descriptor table and every historical-serving diff read first; generated evidence records deferred until these predictions exist.

predictions.point: worker and four D31/D34 predecessor seal members
predictions.expected: Archive/index/manifest digests equal the submitted pins, every indexed member is a unique regular file with exact bytes/hash, worker has 28896 members, predecessors have 223159; no unindexed file or missing member.

predictions.point: literal VirGL enum and verbatim Mesa channels/swizzles before native assertions
predictions.expected: Exactly IDs 5,6,7,8,122,131,135,308,319,320,321,407,409 map to the declared original UNORM names. Independent cumulative channel offsets plus swizzles yield every declared rgbaField; native GLES565/4444/5551 offsets are [11,5,0,0]/[12,8,4,0]/[11,6,1,0], REV1010102 offsets [0,10,20,30]. Ignored X implies alpha one; no defined component is ignored.

predictions.point: original D34 gap and current wire old-owner/old-layout records
predictions.expected: All 78 original D34 role/mip inputs refuse with unsupported-resource before any allocation. All 780 old owner and 702 old layout cases still refuse. Selected storage alone admits those formats. Legacy233 descriptor/command/compiler boundaries equal base bytes and authenticated dependencies.

predictions.point: each complete initial physical plane and public transfer; dense runs
predictions.expected: Ten dense16 inputs enumerate every word 0..65535. Native fields reconstruct every defined original bit exactly; opaque alpha reads one, with only original ignored X canonicalized. Each dense32 covers 0..1023 per defined 10-bit field and alpha endpoints 0..3. Actual texStorage2D uses RGB565/RGBA4/RGB5_A1/RGB10_A2, without RGBA8 storage or an uncharged shadow.

predictions.point: matrix patch, each local copied mip and final original/staging backing
predictions.expected: Partial box changes exactly its destination texels. All untouched levels/texels and every padding/offset byte retain original values. Native NEAREST blits copy only selected original levels into corresponding local levels; no CPU download occurs during range refresh. GPU-only clear changes the appropriate native plane and retained refresh, leaving original backing unchanged.

predictions.point: caller state before/after opaque allocation and native range refresh
predictions.expected: Global mask, each indexed mask when actual extension is available, scissor enable/box, caller framebuffer/texture/buffer and pack/unpack state are restored. Explicitly masked optional indexed extension preserves global mask/scissor and still initializes opaque alpha one.

Texture GPU charge is sum of packed mip pixels times 2 or4 bytes. Public source/staging backings cost CPU only. Read scratch and actual PBO each cost4 bytes/pixel; scratch is charged at prepare, GPU PBO only after issue, both return on release. One-byte-short CPU/scratch/PBO limits refuse before allocating native staging. All final budget values are zero.

predictions.point: native read issue, completed clientWaitSync, getBufferSubData, cancellation/dispose records
predictions.expected: Each CPU async capture follows its own actually completed native fence. Every fence and native object is retired exactly once. Cancel-before/after-begin, owner/backend disposal and actual context loss cannot publish invalid pixels or leak charges/objects.

predictions.point: detached-generation/context reuse held range and retained old storage read
predictions.expected: Replacement ID gets a distinct generation and native texture. Stale public tickets/views refuse. Held old private mip planes and retained read still equal original old words until their last hold/fence release. Live and GPU budgets reflect retained old allocations until release and return to zero at disposal.

predictions.point: wire ownership/getter/trap/overflow/config/resource/transfer refusals and fresh critic negatives
predictions.expected: Accessors never execute; hostile records/prototypes/traps, unsigned overflow and invalid roles/levels/strides/boxes cannot mutate resources/backings, charge budgets or issue native commands. Caller input mutation cannot alter owned uploaded bytes.
Each actual injected native fault is reached, returns backend-error, releases pending storage/staging/scratch once and ends with zero budgets; failed operation never authorizes output.

predictions.point: fresh completed-word control after uploadFence and distinct sabotageFence
predictions.expected: An actual packed R bit flip after the first fence, completed behind a different actual fence, changes native target component and fails the unchanged full-plane inverse. Independent Python inverse finds the same mismatch; upload-lane/copy-level controls also fail after real native completion.

predictions.point: every smallest governing V8 partition over every added runtime line
predictions.expected: Each part has a positive innermost counter under matching recorded source bytes. Rebuilding complete offset partitions independently yields 449 positive, zero zero-hit, zero waivers. No changed branch is credited by a coarser enclosing positive range.

predictions.point: hot/cold receipts, logs, scrubbed clone report and source closure
predictions.expected: Both successful acceptance commands are exactly make verify-E6-T11d35 at recorded b6434e33 head, all runtime bytes equal freeze and submission. Cold checkout is clean before/after, disallowed ambient vars removed, identical accepted command passes. Generated Wasm digest remains acbe036afcdc4f1d8aa8cfb0fb107f48ba27759a6af4a7b9d6c83e3aa679d6cc.

predictions.point: seven historical gate results, 27 serving declarations and authority surfaces
predictions.expected: All affected historical gates pass actual native recordings. Removing only pinned added module declarations reconstructs every original D34 file exactly, with no algorithm/assertion change. Decoder/state/compiler/crates/web/guest/capset runtime bytes remain base-identical; no production or command authority is claimed.

predictions.point: novel fresh alias/mip/odd-offset partial-box transaction before inspecting its captures
predictions.expected: Using distinct original R/B aliases and ignored-X values in partial reads/writes to nonzero mip levels, independent original-field predictions match full native components and full padded SG backing. Caller FBO/pack/unpack/indexed/scissor state and exact budgets survive; stale generation and one-byte-short reservation attempts leave the physical target unchanged.

predictionCorrections.basis: Unchanged renderer/virgl-command/resources-README.md:270-276 says the backend owns an isolated renderer context and does not restore external bindings. This is a source-contract correction before the novel capture, not a product finding or an observation-based prediction.
predictionCorrections.corrected: Opaque initialization restores caller draw-FBO/global/indexed masks and scissor; range refresh restores read/draw FBOs and scissor. Upload/read establish canonical dense pack/unpack state and their own bindings despite hostile caller state; external texture/PBO/pack/unpack bindings need not restore. Every partial output/native/backing/budget prediction remains required.

scope: private packed normalized storage/transfer ownership only; no original command consumer, guest execution, capset, deployment or production API authority
